## Start here

- [Prompt assembly and provenance](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/architecture/prompt-assembly-provenance.md): Separate ordered prompt sections, runtime-fact snapshots, and tool schemas; measure Plan and Code Mode with explicit execution and cache evidence.
- [GitFlow guardrails](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/agent-patterns/gitflow-guardrails.md): Turn branch-role rules into a pre-execution Agent guard with external audit evidence, while retaining repository branch protection as the final authority.
- [Text-model vision fallback](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/integrations/text-model-vision-fallback.md): Route images through a configured vision adapter while preserving the base Agent model, evidence provenance, privacy boundaries, and measurable cost.
- [Concurrent DSH_HOME session membership](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/concurrent-dsh-home-session-membership.md): Diagnose shared workspace-store write races, distinguish durable-account inspection from validated membership, isolate concurrent profiles, and recover Session membership without deleting logs.
- [Client-module preload mismatch](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/web-client-plugin-boot-failure.md): Diagnose HTML/module revision drift, proxy rewrites, and preload contract failures before touching plugin packages.
- [Context compression profiles](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/architecture/context-compression-profiles.md): Separate Fresh, History, and TailTrim paths, preserve recoverable evidence, and measure cache invalidation, latency, and cost together.
- [Subagent model and reasoning-route fidelity](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/spawn-subagent-reasoning-effort.md): Distinguish live UI model selection from Session-start snapshots and child request headers before attributing cost or effort behavior.
- [Session and renderer memory boundaries](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/session-heap-growth.html): Separate Web ChatView DOM growth from Host Session retention, then choose renderer virtualization or Session handoff based on process-level evidence.
- [Verify official project identity](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/reference/official-project-identity.md): Distinguish the official runtime from third-party desktop shells, packages, and sites by checking artifact, IPC, profile, and credential provenance.
- [Agent lifecycle and prefix-cache ordering](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/architecture/agent-lifecycle.md): Trace turns and steps, then separate provenance, recency, durable order, and cache stability before moving injected context.
- [Agent Harness Evaluation Scorecard](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/agent-harness-scorecard.html): Rate eight runtime boundaries with evidence, identify the next gate, and share a local browser-only review.

- [Diagnose ask_user_question aborts](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/ask-user-question-aborted.html): Prove rc.2 has no implicit answer timer, correlate the execution signal and provider lifecycle, and keep reminders distinct from typed deadlines.
- [Diagnose unknown edit tools](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/unknown-edit-tool.html): Distinguish Standard, Minimal, Code, Both, and custom Agent tool surfaces before routing lookup, freshness, path, schema, sandbox, or permission failures.
- [Restore clipped Settings plugin navigation](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/settings-plugin-nav-overflow.html): Repair the flex chain so every registered section remains scrollable, focusable, and clickable without moving fixed dialog chrome.
- [Design Session Collections without invented Workspaces](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/session-groups-workspace-less.html): Keep navigation membership outside Session identity, cwd, sandbox, archive, and retention; offer explicit conversation-only, ephemeral, or attach-later execution profiles.
- [DeepSeek Harness AGENTS.md scope and enforcement map](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/deepseek-harness-agents-md.html): Separate discovery, model visibility, probabilistic instruction following, and deterministic enforcement; diagnose scope, refresh, budget, and the rc.2 DSH_HOME collision.
- [DeepSeek Harness CLI map](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/deepseek-harness-cli.html): Distinguish the shipped profile launcher from terminal chat, inspect compositions, run one headless task, interpret process evidence, and audit a community TUI.
- [Windows folder-picker crash and truncation guide](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/windows-folder-picker-crash.html): Separate Node/Koffi aborts, UTF-16LE U+XX00 path corruption, incomplete native installation, and stale ownership, then switch safely to the shipped browse backend.
- [Windows Web Host post-message hang](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/windows-web-event-loop-hang.html): Join the listener PID to timestamped HTTP probes and three private full dumps, then distinguish a stable thread wait from provider, proxy, persistence, and watchdog correlations.
- [DeepSeek API fetch failure guide](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/deepseek-api-fetch-failed.html): Separate browser ingress, Node proxy routing, enterprise CA trust, DNS/TCP transport, and provider HTTP responses without disabling TLS.
- [DeepSeek Harness MCP guide](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/deepseek-harness-mcp.html): Add one server to a user Agent preset, start a fresh Session generation, and route stdio, HTTP, discovery, registration, and reconnect failures.
- [DeepSeek Harness memory architecture](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/deepseek-harness-memory.html): Separate Sessions, compaction, Skills, application records, and cross-session memory; migrate Codex or Claude Code state with provenance, isolation, and rollback evidence.
- [Keep DeepSeek Harness Session roots single-writer](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/deepseek-harness-single-writer.html): Isolate concurrent Web, headless, ACP, SDK, service, and test processes or serialize shared-history ownership handoffs.
- [Recover spawn ENOENT after a workspace moves](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/workspace-moved-spawn-enoent.html): Prove the shell executable exists, test the exact Session cwd, and choose a recovery that preserves workspace identity.
- [Upgrade and roll back DeepSeek Harness](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/upgrade-deepseek-harness.html): Capture the known-good executable, profile, config, and Sessions; test an exact target in isolation; pass compatibility gates; and prove rollback.
- [Community plugin and marketplace audit](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/deepseek-harness-plugin-audit.html): Bind runtime verdicts to exact package and runner evidence, keep compatibility distinct from security review, authorize Host mutations, diff the resolved composition, and prove rollback and cleanup.
- [Install DeepSeek Harness safely](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/install-deepseek-harness.html): Verify the official package, choose exact npx, project-local, source, or global execution, and capture executable, profile state, and workspace evidence.
- [DeepSeek Harness Skills guide](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/deepseek-harness-skills.html): Create a project Skill, understand progressive disclosure, test model and user invocation, and debug roots, precedence, policy, and hot refresh.
- [Build your first DeepSeek Harness plugin](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/first-deepseek-harness-plugin.html): Load a local TypeScript module, convert Windows drive paths to file URLs, type-check the scratch project, package a bundle, inspect it, and remove it cleanly.
- [Custom plugin Session event registration and compatibility](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/custom-session-events.html): Design optional observations, required state, foreign imports, schema ownership, cold-reader lifecycle, and global search isolation after alpha.1 removed the historical envelope marker.
- [Fix the HMR expose-internals startup error](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/hmr-expose-internals.html): Route the shared Web, headless, and custom-profile lifecycle; verify pinned pnpm and helper resolution; and use the direct Node flag only as a disposable diagnostic.
- [Code Mode worker-thread trust boundary](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/code-mode-security-boundary.html): Separate worker reliability containment from enforceable OS isolation, inspect exposure without an escape proof, and choose native tools or a constrained outer boundary.
- [Fix ReplaceFileW EACCES on Windows](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/windows-replacefile-eacces.html): Distinguish an HMR watcher conflict from ACL denial, then stop, back up, edit, validate, restart, and roll back without exposing partial YAML.
- [Diagnose slow TTFT](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/slow-ttft.html): Split time-to-first-token into Host outbound, provider, and Host inbound intervals, then test mature Session event volume and concurrent model steps independently.
- [Recover a poisoned Session](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/poisoned-session-recovery.html): Diagnose recurring `400 INVALID_REQUEST` after truncated tool-call JSON, export the durable evidence, and recover without editing a live compressed log.
- [Design multi-Session Web presentation](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/multi-session-presentation-contract.html): Separate visible membership from focused interaction, bind every pane to explicit Session identity, negotiate Client plugin multiplicity, and preserve single-pane compatibility.
- [Extend the Web UI with a persistent Client plugin](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/persistent-web-ui-client-plugin.html): Replace installed-file patches with a separately packaged SlotMap extension, then prove manifest discovery, browser loading, scoped rendering, removal, and upgrade compatibility.
- [Generate Typert artifacts for an out-of-tree plugin](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/out-of-tree-typert-generation.html): Route workspace discovery and real-path containment, prove external public wire-type exports, and test that strict fixed-object codecs reject unknown fields before business state changes.
- [Recover insufficient tool messages](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/insufficient-tool-messages.html): Stop repeated provider 400s when a scheduler failure leaves assistant tool calls without results, then verify unknown side effects before replay.
- [Diagnose empty streamed tool identity](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/streamed-tool-call-identity.html): Trace explicit empty continuation fields that overwrite a valid call ID and name before tool policy, then isolate the affected route safely.
- [Route a runaway or narrative-only Agent loop](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/runaway-agent-loop.html): Count durable events, distinguish one degenerate stream from repeated turns and steps, find the wake source, and stop automatically sourced actionless rounds without interpreting prose as a tool call.
- [Bound live Session heap growth and cold restore](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/session-heap-growth.html): Separate model context, the append-only resident Session log, durable history, synchronous cold reconstruction, desktop supervision, and runtime-copy drift; preserve the triggering artifact while isolating a restart loop.
- [Control stale pending subagent follow-ups](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/subagent-inbox-control.html): Derive one direct parent's eligible unclaimed follow-up subsequence from the shared Agent inbox, then list, cancel, replace, or reorder it without touching runtime notices or hiding claim races.
- [Declare a tool-owned code-card language](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/tool-code-card-language.html): Add a provider-neutral grammar hint to an execute call view, prefer explicit tool intent over the reserved wire name, and keep presentation metadata outside execution, policy, and runtime authority.
- [Protect live session logs](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/session-log-durability.html): Stop the writer before backup or repair, then separate missing paths, sequence gaps, torn tails, and tool-call identity corruption.
- [Recover session history safely](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/session-history-recovery.html): Reconcile physical, Host-history, client-assembly, and rendered tail sequences; route framing, ordering, identity, projection, false exhaustion, and temporary Web cutoffs without destroying evidence.
- [Resume historical code-preset Sessions](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/historical-code-preset-resume.md): Bridge the durable `code` preset identity to alpha.1's `ptc` composition with an owned user-level alias, preserve the Session, and migrate ongoing work without rewriting history.
- [Fix a missing /bin/bash](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/pty-shell-path.html): Configure the terminal-bash preset row with the exact executable path on NixOS, containers, and other non-FHS hosts.
- [Connect local Ollama](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/ollama-local-provider.html): Configure the custom-provider form, prove reachability from the Harness host, and diagnose container localhost failures.
- [Bound subagent scale](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/subagent-scale-oom.html): Separate concurrency from total-agent limits and turn large fan-out jobs into measured, restartable batches.
- [Profile repair, reset, and plugin compatibility recovery](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/plugin-recovery.html): Classify default, user-layer, Bundle, dependency, activation, and runtime-export failures; choose one compatible closure and prove cold boot without erasing the Harness home.
- [Fix missing dsh-client-schema-form](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/missing-client-schema-form.html): Separate the plugin import from the DSH distribution closure and avoid creating a second internal runtime copy.
- [Fix pnpm workspace-root plugin installation](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/pnpm-adding-to-root.html): Resolve `ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT`, then verify dependency, materialization, bundle activation, and composed configuration.
- [Version evidence](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/version-evidence.html): Separate moving npm dist-tags, immutable published artifacts, the installed executable, and the source revision before reporting a failure.
- [Official DeepSeek Harness identity](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/official-deepseek-harness.html): Verify the DeepSeek AI repository, scoped npm package, rc.7 release commit, executable, and independent handbook boundary before installing.
- [DeepSeek Harness field status](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/field-status.html): rc.7 baseline plus alpha.1 migration context for installation, sessions, sandboxing, remote Web, Windows paths, and MCP configuration, with primary evidence and safer next actions.
- [Interactive failure router](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/diagnose.html): Pick the first broken boundary and get the first evidence, command, success signal, and focused guide.
- [What is DeepSeek Harness?](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/what-is-deepseek-harness.md): Separate the model, provider API, runtime, profile, tools, policy, and session layers.
- [Fix reasoning replay across providers and thinking modes](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/pi-ai-cross-provider-reasoning-replay.md): Separate missing `reasoning_content` on pi-ai cross-provider routes from stale reasoning history on direct DeepSeek thinking-off requests, then apply the matching containment.
- [DeepSeek Harness vs Claude Code vs Codex](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/deepseek-harness-vs-claude-code-vs-codex.html): Choose a control plane by runtime ownership, extension contracts, policy, state, and the product being shipped.
- [DeepSeek Harness Session log format](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/deepseek-harness-session-log-format.html): Decode concatenated Zstandard frames and packed text, reasoning, and tool-call rows into a contiguous logical event stream.
- [Invalid overlay boot recovery](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/invalid-overlay-boot-failure.html): Recover outside Web when an unresolved user-layer insert prevents a profile from booting.
- [Five-minute Web quickstart](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/getting-started/quickstart.md): Run a bounded first task and inspect the resolved runtime graph.
- [Headless Agent](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/getting-started/headless-agent.md): Operate one non-interactive task with explicit artifacts and exit evidence.
- [Python SDK](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/getting-started/python-sdk.md): Embed the runtime over its JSON-RPC lifecycle.
- [MCP integration](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/integrations/mcp.md): Diagnose process, transport, handshake, registration, and policy separately.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/README.md): Route symptoms to the provider, loop, tool, policy, sandbox, or session layer.
- [Subagent route inheritance incident note](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/subagent-route-inheritance.html): Diagnose and mitigate child agents using a stale provider route or unexpected credential.
- [Remote Web control-plane guide](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/remote-web-secure-context.html): Prove when typed UUID minting aborts readiness and event streams before fetch, separate that reconnect loop from Origin 403 responses, and choose SSH localhost or an authenticated HTTPS gateway.
- [Remote Settings authentication and capability boundary](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/remote-settings-loopback.html): Distinguish the rc.2 non-loopback unavailable mirror from a 403, then design separate gateway identity, browser principals, narrow Settings grants, secret handling, audit, CSRF, and revocation.
- [Session hard-link compatibility](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/session-hard-link-unsupported.html): Recover first-flush link failures by moving the Session root while preserving atomic, no-overwrite publication.
- [Cross-platform pnpm entrypoint](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/windows-standalone-pnpm.html): Fix rc.8 runners that pass an ELF binary, POSIX launcher, or Windows executable to Node through npm_execpath.
- [Windows console-window flash](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/windows-console-window-flash.html): Route local subprocess and restricted-token ACL sandbox process creation separately without disabling the sandbox.
- [Corrupt package manifest at boot](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/corrupt-package-json-profile-boot.html): Find every malformed package.json behind a pathless JSON SyntaxError and repair the owning installation closure.
- [pi-ai server_error retry](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/pi-ai-server-error-retry.html): Route flattened overload text through classification, provider policy, and durable llm/retry event evidence.
- [Operator cheat sheet](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/reference/cheat-sheet.md): Commands, evidence checks, and production boundaries.

## Download

- [DeepSeek Harness Field Guide v0.1.0](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/releases/download/v0.1.0/DeepSeek-Harness-Field-Guide-v0.1.0.pdf): Ten-page visual PDF for onboarding and offline reference.

## Project boundary

This is a community-maintained handbook from SandBase, not an official DeepSeek AI project. Version-sensitive claims link to primary sources and record verification dates.
- [Fix pnpm global native-binding resolution](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/pnpm-global-native-binding.html): Preserve the isolated store, trace the helper from its physical owner, and compare an exact project-local install before changing dependency visibility.
- [Fix macOS workspace picker paths](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/macos-workspace-picker.html): Distinguish valid spaces from a leaked terminal HFS colon, preserve realpath identity, and test the picker plus registry boundary.
- [Todo stuck in progress](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/todo-stuck-in-progress.html): Trace the last whole-list `todo/write`, final assistant message, turn-ending reason, and Host projection; reconcile with one bounded stop reminder without inventing completion.
- [Code Mode Skill context gap](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/code-mode-skill-context.html): Separate the nested canonical value, durable UI dispatch, outer `run_code` result, and next model request; repair instruction delivery without injecting every intermediate result.
- [Windows Minimal preset Bash failure](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/windows-minimal-bash.html): Route the exact win32 terminal-inspection error through preset, persistent PTY, subprocess, and platform-inspector boundaries before changing commands or permissions.
- [Windows first workspace-write freeze](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/windows-acl-first-run.html): Separate synchronous first-use ACL propagation from model latency, sandbox denial, and preset mismatch; preserve fail-closed behavior in any async repair.
- [Windows compatibility, ACL, and native exit triage](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/windows-native-exit.html): Decode 3221226505 as 0xC0000409 without guessing, identify the terminated process, correlate WER and a private dump, preserve Session durability evidence, and change one boundary at a time.
- [Subagent unknown Job identity](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/subagent-unknown-job.html): Route foreground run IDs, one-shot background Job IDs, and continuable child IDs before reconciling partial multi-agent output.
- [Session-scoped MCP across ACP](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/acp-session-mcp.html): Compare Host-per-tenant, deployment allowlist, authenticated gateway, and direct HTTP designs while rc.2 rejects client-supplied MCP servers.
- [Synology NAS source deployment](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/synology-nas.html): Keep Node, pnpm workspace links, native ABI, cwd-stable launch, service identity, and authenticated remote access as separate deployment gates.
- [Missing question or approval card](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/missing-question-card.html): Separate silent dead sockets from replay-then-resync clearing; recover authentic consent without manufacturing an answer.
- [Output token limit reached](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/output-token-limit.html): Separate request maxTokens, provider output capability, and remaining context headroom; retain partial output and recover in a bounded next turn.
- [Git plugin missing dist or lib exports](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/git-plugin-missing-dist.html): Separate a blocked build, a bypassed build, and a broken runtime artifact; remove the bundle without booting Web and verify the exact packed bytes before reinstalling.
- [Compaction summary truncated at the token cap](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/compaction-summary-truncated.html): Separate local-server context shift from durable Session compaction; diagnose MAX_TOKENS, preserve the original surface, and tune the summary cap or route.
- [Plugin peer-dependency warnings](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/plugin-peer-warnings.html): Separate expected Host-provided peers, real compatibility mismatches, missing third-party peers, and blocked build scripts without duplicating runtime singletons.
- [Response and reasoning language](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/response-language.html): Separate user instruction, deployment persona, provider reasoning, gateway injection, and Web locale before changing language controls.
- [Prompt send recovery](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/prompt-send-recovery.html): Distinguish Host admission from a durable user message, recover missing text safely, and avoid replaying ambiguous side effects.
